use_custom_grid_sample: use the custom grid_sample function as a drop-in replacement for torch.nn.functional.grid_sample with high-order gradient support
enable_custom_op: enable the custom grid sample operation by setting the enabled flag to True for PyTorch 1.7-1.9
check_custom_op_support: check if the custom grid sample op is supported by calling _should_use_custom_op to verify PyTorch version compatibility
review_GridSample2dForward: review the _GridSample2dForward autograd function that performs bilinear grid sampling and saves inputs for backward pass
review_GridSample2dBackward: review the _GridSample2dBackward autograd function that computes second-order gradients using the internal aten grid sampler operation
